plugin.description: A counter on a key: pressing it counts up, holding it counts down or resets.

Counter.description: Counts presses and shows the current number on the key. A short press adds one, a long press subtracts one or resets to 0.

restore.description: Keep the number across restarts. Turn it off to always start at 0.

on_long_drop_down.description: What a long press does: "Subtract" counts one down, "Revert" sets the counter back to 0.

save_to_file.description: Also write the current number into a text file, so other programs can read it.

file_path.description: The file to write the number into. Only used with save_to_file.
